name: Greyspire Pass
summary: The one practical way through or around the Stone Crown's southern shoulder: a long valley of pass-forts ending at Greyspire itself, the fortress-seat of Northmarch. Whoever keeps the pass keeps the bargains between crown, mountain, and forest.

geography.character: fortified valley road: toll-stations, mine-heads, watch-towers at bowshot intervals

notable_sites.name: Greyspire
notable_sites.note: The pass-fortress at the valley mouth — seat of Earl Maren. Its light never goes out; the March considers that policy, not superstition.

crossings.name: The Iron Toll-Station
crossings.note: Weights sworn on iron scales; disputes settled by re-weighing, never by argument.

lore_notes: The King's Road ends against the pass from the south; beyond it, mountain tracks belong to the March and the deep-folk by separate ancient custom.
Ore goes down, grain goes up, and the ledger is the true treaty between Northmarch and the Sunken Holds.
adventure_hooks: Silver shipments vanish between toll-stations — inside work or something listening under the snow?
A Warden-Earl dies without heir while three parties hold competing charters to the pass.
